description:
* Define, analyze, and structure system requirements for humanoid robotic platforms and related subsystems.
* Work closely with Product Managers, R&D leadership, Software, Hardware, and QA teams to gather, clarify, and align business and technical requirements.
* Translate high-level product needs into detailed, actionable, and testable system requirements.
* Develop and maintain requirement hierarchies and decomposition from:
System → Subsystem → Component
* Ensure requirements are complete, consistent, traceable, and free of conflicts.
* Act as the primary bridge between Software (Perception, Planning, Control, AI) and Hardware (Mechanical, Electrical, Actuators) teams.
* Establish and maintain end-to-end traceability across:
Requirements → Design → Implementation → Verification & Validation
* Collaborate with QA and Test Engineering teams to define acceptance criteria, verification methods, and test coverage.
* Support design reviews, requirement reviews, risk assessments, and change management activities.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of requirement engineering practices, templates, and development processes.
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions to drive alignment and ensure successful product delivery.
requirements_text:
Relevant Education and Experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Automation, or related technical disciplines.
* 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following roles: Technical Business Analyst; System Analyst; Requirement Engineer...
* Proven experience defining, documenting, and managing technical requirements for complex systems.
* Strong understanding of system engineering principles and requirement management methodologies.
* Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Ability to convert ambiguous business or product requirements into clear technical specifications.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and systems-thinking capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
* Experience working in Robotics, Autonomous Systems, Automotive, Industrial Automation, Embedded Systems, or related industries.
* Hands-on experience with humanoid robots or intelligent robotic systems.
* Familiarity with Systems Engineering methodologies, including V-Model development processes.
* Understanding of requirement traceability, verification, validation, and risk management practices.
* Exposure to functional safety, compliance standards, or regulated product development environments.
* Experience working in fast-paced R&D organizations developing complex hardware-software integrated products.
